{"metadata":{"description":"A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) agent preset for institutional multi-factor stock-selection research: methodology knowledge base + zero-dependency factor statistics.","id":"gh:1334728853","install_available":false,"language":"Rust","name":"dsh-factor-investing","slug":"Nzssm1/dsh-factor-investing","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","factor-investing","quant"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) agent preset for institutional multi-factor stock-selection research: metho"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"dology knowledge base + zero-dependency factor statistics."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-factor-investing · Multi-Factor Stock-Selection Quant Researcher"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) community **agent preset** for institutional multi-factor stock selection ("},{"id":"p3s2","text":"A-share oriented). It turns the broker/hedge-fund multi-factor pipeline into a discipline-aware rese"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"archer: a methodology knowledge base covering the full pipeline, plus a **deterministic Rust core** "},{"id":"p3s4","text":"for reproducible factor statistics."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"> Community project — NOT an official DeepSeek preset and not endorsed by DeepSeek. See Relationship"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"ject — NOT an official DeepSeek preset and not endorsed by DeepSeek. See Relationship with DeepSeek."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## 1. Introduction"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- **preset id**: `dsh-factor-investing` (the directory name; must match `[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*`)
- **di"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"splay name**: 多因子选股量化研究员 (Multi-Factor Stock-Selection Quant Researcher)
- **positioning**: institut"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"ional research assistant for data → factors → testing → synthesis → portfolio → backtest → monitorin"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"g
- **scenarios**: factor mining & testing (IC/IR, Fama-MacBeth, incremental alpha), factor preproce"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"ssing & synthesis, Barra risk models, portfolio optimization, backtesting & live monitoring, quant c"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"ode reproduction
- **computation architecture**: all core numeric work is delegated to a Rust CLI (`"},{"id":"p6s7","text":"scripts/factor-stats`); the Agent writes only factor definitions and glue code"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## 2. Why this preset"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"A generic chat model reduces "multi-factor" to "sum a few factors" and treats "good backtest = valid"},{"id":"p8s2","text":" factor". Institutional multi-factor is an **industrial pipeline**, and its real edge over retail pr"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"actice is **statistical discipline**:"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- A factor's IC looking good ≠ useful — a new factor must pass an **incremental-alpha test** (regres"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"s its returns on known factors; the intercept α must be significant) to be genuinely new information"},{"id":"p9s3","text":";
- skipping size neutralization = an implicit small-cap bet; skipping industry neutralization = a v"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"alue factor that always picks banks;
- multiple-testing correction (t>3 for novel factors), out-of-s"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"ample discipline, and cost/fill-rate assumptions decide whether a backtest is believable at all."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"This preset writes that discipline into the system prompt via the persona, ships the methodology as "},{"id":"p10s2","text":"a skill for on-demand loading, and pins the numeric algorithms in Rust so the same data and version "},{"id":"p10s3","text":"produce the same numbers every time."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## 3. How it works"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Three parts, all shipped with the repo:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"1. **persona (system prompt)** — `agent.cordis.yml` injects a quant-researcher identity through `@de"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"epseek-ai/dsh-persona`, embedding the pipeline, core discipline, and the hard rule that the Agent on"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"ly writes factor definitions/glue code while all core computations go through the Rust CLI.
2. **ski"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"ll (on-demand methodology)** — `skills/factor-investing-pipeline/` is registered through `@deepseek-"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"ai/dsh-skill-filesystem`'s `customSkillDirs`; the model loads the relevant chapter with the `skill` "},{"id":"p13s6","text":"tool.
3. **Rust core engine** — `src/` + `Cargo.toml` implement winsorization (MAD/3σ/percentile), s"},{"id":"p13s7","text":"tandardization, neutralization, IC/ICIR, two-stage Fama-MacBeth, Gram-Schmidt orthogonalization; `sc"},{"id":"p13s8","text":"ripts/factor-stats` is the stable JSON-in/JSON-out CLI and the Agent's only computation entry point."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"The toolset keeps the full `standard` coding capability; only the identity and knowledge change, so "},{"id":"p14s2","text":"the tool catalog — and thus the request-prefix cache — stays stable."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## 4. Rust CLI usage"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Every command reads one JSON object from stdin and writes JSON to stdout; `null` represents missing/"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"NaN values in both directions. Errors go to stderr with a non-zero exit. See `RUST_CORE.md` for the "},{"id":"p16s3","text":"full command list and JSON fields."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Commands: `mean`, `std`, `median`, `mad`, `quantile`, `rank`, `corr`, `spearman`, `winsorize-mad`, `"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"winsorize-sigma`, `winsorize-percentile`, `zscore`, `neutralize`, `ols`, `pearson-ic`, `spearman-ran"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"k-ic`, `ic-series`, `icir`, `ic-tstat`, `fama-macbeth`, `gram-schmidt`."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## 5. Layout"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## 6. Installation"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"DSH discovers local presets under `<dshHome>/.agent-presets/` (`dshHome` defaults to `~/.dsh`; `%USE"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"RPROFILE%\.dsh` on Windows). The preset `id` is the directory name, so clone the repo as that direct"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"FILE%\.dsh` on Windows). The preset `id` is the directory name, so clone the repo as that directory."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"**Linux / macOS:**"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"**Windows (PowerShell):**"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"Restart DSH and pick 「多因子选股量化研究员」 for a new session. If your deployment configures custom preset roo"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"ts, place the repo under that root instead (`dsh-agent-presets` `roots`)."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"Rust toolchain requirement: the first `scripts/factor-stats` call needs `cargo` (Rust stable). Insta"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"ll from <https://rustup.rs>."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## 7. Verification"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"1. **persona active** — the first system prompt of a new session carries the quant-researcher identi"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"ty, pipeline/discipline, and the Rust-computation rule (including "Rust core is read-only").
2. **sk"},{"id":"p30s3","text":"ill registered** — ask "list skills"; `factor-investing-pipeline` should appear, or ask it to "load "},{"id":"p30s4","text":"chapter ch04 of factor-investing-pipeline".
3. **Rust core works** — run `cargo test --locked` (24 R"},{"id":"p30s5","text":"ust tests pass) or `echo '{"values":[1,2,3,4]}' | scripts/factor-stats mean` → `2.5`.
4. **full test"},{"id":"p30s6","text":"s** — `npm test` runs `cargo test --locked`."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"## 9. Compatibility"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"- Built for **DeepSeek Harness 0.1.0-rc.6**: `preset.yml` (display metadata) + `agent.cordis.yml` (C"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"ordis composition) + `@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona` (persona) + `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem` `cus"},{"id":"p32s3","text":"tomSkillDirs` (preset-local skill).
- This is a **domain-expert preset**, not the older (0.1.0-rc.5 "},{"id":"p32s4","text":"/ commit 47f9438) "two-stage tool catalog" pattern that hand-wrote a `system-prompt/assemble` listen"},{"id":"p32s5","text":"er. In the current version the system prompt comes from `@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona`, and "the catalog"},{"id":"p32s6","text":" changes once" is satisfied by not changing it at all.
- **Manual confirmations**: ① repo name vs. p"},{"id":"p32s7","text":"reset id (rename the directory if they differ); ② the copyright holder in `LICENSE` (currently `Nzss"},{"id":"p32s8","text":"m1`); ③ whether your deployment sets custom preset roots (default `~/.dsh/.agent-presets/`); ④ on a "},{"id":"p32s9","text":"non-rc.6 deployment, field names for `customSkillDirs` / `dsh-persona` may differ — check that versi"},{"id":"p32s10","text":"on's `dsh-agent-presets` / `dsh-persona` README."}],"truncated":true}
